    np.fill_diagonal(pheromone, 0)

    beta = 5.0

                prob = (tau ** alpha) * (eta[i, :] ** beta)
                prob[list(visited)] = 0
                prob_sum = prob.sum()

                    next_city = np.random.choice(choices)

                    next_city = np.random.choice(n, p=prob)

                visited.add(next_city)
